patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section featuring a prominent interactive calculator on one side and a large, illustrative headline on the other, creating a dynamic and engaging first impression.
Vibrant, contrasting accent colors (red, yellow, blue, green, purple) are used against a mix of light, dark, and pastel section backgrounds, creating a playful yet clear visual hierarchy.
Scroll-triggered section reveals where content elements (text, cards, images) subtly fade up or slide into view as their parent section enters the viewport, enhancing engagement.
Each major content section is visually separated and branded using distinctive, full-bleed background colors or large, custom illustrations.
Headings utilize a bold, rounded, and playful sans-serif typeface, often presented within 'speech bubble' shapes for emphasis and a friendly tone.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations (likely css-keyframes or a JS library) that cause elements to fade in and slightly translate upwards as they become visible in the viewport. Background elements in the hero and 'Send across borders' sections feature continuous, subtle animations (likely lottie or css-keyframes) to add a dynamic, playful feel. The top banner, main navigation, and cookie consent bar remain fixed at the top and bottom of the viewport, respectively, as the user scrolls.
The site heavily relies on large, custom, vector-based illustrations with a rounded, friendly aesthetic, often integrated as full-bleed background elements or interactive components.
Information is often presented in distinct, rounded card-like containers or 'speech bubble' shapes, providing clear visual separation and a consistent playful theme.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, rounded headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text, creating a clear hierarchy with a playful character.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly rounded corners, often approaching pill-like shapes for buttons, cards, and decorative elements, contributing to the site's friendly aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable spacing within content blocks, ensuring readability and visual breathing room.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, playful, custom illustrations and animated background elements, combined with a bold, rounded typography style, creates an unusually approachable and friendly aesthetic for a financial service, effectively softening the typically serious tone of fintech.
